# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities in Lip Service through
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/hunterbohm/lip-service/security/advisories/new).
Please do not disclose them publicly until there has been a reasonable opportunity to investigate
and remediate them.

Include the Lip Service version, your macOS version, and the steps to reproduce. Of most interest
are problems with the permissions the app holds (Microphone and Accessibility), what it does with
the clipboard and keystrokes, the checks on the speech models it downloads, the tokens it keeps in
the Keychain, and the signature on each release. For a bug that is not a security problem, use the
[bug report form](https://github.com/hunterbohm/lip-service/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).

Fixes go into the latest release.
